episodes.title: Black Clover: Born With ZERO Magic?! Asta's Secret ⚔️ #Shorts
episodes.script: In a world ruled by magic, Asta was born with none. Everyone around him could cast spells, yet he still dreamed of becoming the Wizard King. episodes.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners — David's Power Had a PRICE 🦾 #Shorts
episodes.script: In Night City, getting stronger can cost you everything. David Martinez lives in a world where money and cybernetic implants decide who gets a chance. Every upgrade promises more speed, strength, and freedom. But the price isn't always written on the label. What makes Cyberpunk: Edgerunners hurt isn't just the violence or the action. episodes.title: Death Note: Why Do the First 40 Seconds Matter? ⏱️ #Shorts
episodes.script: One name. One face. Forty seconds. That's one of the first rules Light discovers in Death Note. When he writes a criminal's name while picturing the person's face, the notebook proves its terrifying power. If no other cause of death is specified, the victim dies of a heart attack after forty seconds. But there's a twist: those forty seconds are also the window for specifying a different cause. Not every death caused by the notebook follows the same countdown. The most frightening part is what Light does after he realizes the rule is real. Would you keep writing?

episodes.script: Kira thought no one could find him. Then L went on television. A man claiming to be the detective challenged Kira on live TV. episodes.title: Death Note: Kira Had Access to POLICE Files?! 👁️ #Shorts
episodes.script: What if Kira could read the police investigation against him? In Death Note, L notices that many deaths happen on a student's schedule. But Light has a dangerous advantage: his father works on the case, and Light can access sensitive police information. He changes the timing of deaths to throw L off. Instead, the pattern suggests that Kira might have a connection to the investigation itself. Soon, FBI agents are watching people close to the police. Then Ryuk offers Light a terrifying bargain: the Shinigami Eyes, in exchange for half his remaining lifespan. Would you take that deal?
